Lattice-based incremental hash APIs with zero, add, sub, and Base58 encoding helpers.

# Purpose
Defines the `fd_lthash_value_t` type and helper functions for a lattice-based incremental hash built on `blake3`. The file sets the hash size and alignment, provides inline routines to finalize a `fd_blake3_t` state into a 2048-byte hash, clear a hash to zero, test for zero, and add or subtract hash values as 16-bit word arrays. It also defines macros to encode a hash into a 32-byte Base58 string, with support for a caller-supplied buffer or an `alloca`-based temporary buffer.
